verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a live llms.txt at docs.ramp.com, confirmed by an HTTP 200 probe. The index carries explicit agent usage instructions and automation recommendations. Behind it sit per-guide .txt exports, llms-api.txt and llms-full.txt full exports, and a canonical OpenAPI schema, which a probe confirmed parses with 174 paths. A keyless Developer docs MCP server, verified live and unauthenticated by probe, gives agents live docs search, schema, and read tools.
